concerns.text: T006b (Producer: creates nist_refs.json) is listed AFTER T006a (Consumer: validates nist_refs.json). T006a will fail immediately if T006b has not run. The order must be T006b -> T006a.

T008a, T008b, T008c are marked as 'Blocking Gates' but are placed in the middle of Phase 2 alongside parallel tasks (T004-T007). If these are truly blocking gates requiring external PRs, they should be listed as a distinct prerequisite block BEFORE any implementation tasks (T004-T010) to prevent the illusion of parallel progress on a blocked path.

T027 (Consumer: generates summary table) is listed before T026 (Producer: generates bootstrap_stats.csv) in the implementation list, though the dependency section correctly notes T026 must precede T027. The task list order must reflect the execution order: T026 -> T027.

T021 (Sensitivity Analysis) is marked [P] (parallel-safe) in the task list, but the 'Dependencies & Execution Order' section explicitly states 'T021 cannot run in parallel with T015' and 'T021 depends on T015'. The [P] tag is incorrect and misleading; it implies independence from T015 which is false.

T011, T012, T013 (Tests) are marked [P] and listed before T014-T018 (Implementation). While TDD-First is the methodology, the [P] tag implies they can run in parallel with implementation tasks. In a strict dependency graph, tests depend on the code they test. If the intent is 'write tests first', the [P] tag should be removed or clarified to 'Parallel with other tests' only, not 'Parallel with implementation'.
